title: Add RAG step contracts, composable playground fixtures, and docs playground integration
author: Samira Patel
description: Context: teams building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows at Redwood have repeatedly asked for smaller, testable building blocks they can drop into playgrounds and CI. This PR introduces a set of lightweight 'step contracts' (JSON Schema + examples) and a composable playground fixture layer for the docs site so authors can embed runnable step templates with deterministic test fixtures. Motivation: reduce onboarding time for RAG authors; make examples executable in the docs playground; enable deterministic e2e-style unit tests for prompt+tool interactions. What this PR contains: 1) A compact schema for RAG steps (step-contract.json) describing required fields: id, type (retrieve|plan|generate|tool), inputs, outputs, timeouts, and explicit side-effect declarations for tool steps. 2) Ten canonical step templates (examples/steps/) covering common patterns: incremental-retrieval, tool-first-fetch, streaming-generator-with-fallback, cached-kv-prefetch, and async-webhook-ack. 3) Playground fixtures and harness: docs/playground/fixtures/ contains small indexable corpora and deterministic tool stubs (search, http-get, table-lookup) wired to the docs playground runtime. 4) Integration glue: docs/scripts/playground-register.ts registers the step contracts, provides UI annotations for required fields, and wires the fixture runner so examples are runnable in the docs site with a single "Run" click. 5) Test harness: examples/tests/rag-step-fixtures.test.ts contains unit tests that assert consistent outputs across Node 18 and Playwright headless runs (fixture runner mocked). 6) Docs pages: docs/content/guides/rag-step-contracts.md documents the contract and shows minimal and advanced examples, plus migration notes for existing RAG templates. Checklist (manual & CI): - [x] Define JSON Schema and canonical examples - [x] Add docs playground registration and UI helpers - [x] Create deterministic fixtures and tool stubs - [x] Add unit tests and Playwright smoke - [x] Update docs pages with migration notes - [x] Run docs site build and smoke tests Implementation notes: step contracts are intentionally minimal and versioned (v1) so we can extend with typed metadata later (e.g., billing hints, caching policies). The fixture runner supports two modes: readonly (sandboxed, no outbound network) and integration (for local dev). Security: tool stubs run in a sandbox with explicit side_effect flags so the UI warns before executing any non-readonly step. Backwards compatibility: existing examples are untouched; migration guidance is in the docs page. Related: ENG-9218 (authoring UX improvements), DOC-307 (docs playground feature request), SUP-1142 (customer request for reproducible examples). Release notes: Adds reusable RAG step contracts, runnable docs-playground fixtures, and example templates for authors and SDK users. No breaking API changes (contract versioned as v1). How to try it locally: 1) yarn --cwd docs install && yarn --cwd docs dev 2) Open /docs/guides/rag-step-contracts and click the embedded "Run" button on the examples 3) Run examples/tests/rag-step-fixtures.test.ts for CI-like validation Notes for reviewers: focus review on schema ergonomics, fixture determinism, and the docs flow rather than the superficial UI styles. If we want to expose the schema via the public model registry later we should add a short compatibility shim (planned follow-up).

review_comments: Ethan Liu: Overall this looks great; a couple of schema nitpicks: prefer 'timeout_ms' over 'timeout' to avoid ambiguous units. Also please add an explicit 'deterministic' boolean flag for fixtures.
Samira Patel (author): Good catches — switched to timeout_ms and added deterministic flag on fixture metadata. Updated tests to assert deterministic mode by default.
Priya Nair: Playground UX is nice. Can we add a small 'Explain' mode that surfaces which step produced which tokens in the generator case? Not required for v1 but should be easy to add later.
Samira Patel: ACK — opened follow-up linear ENG-9322 to add Explain UI and trace links. Kept playground minimal for v1 to reduce scope.
Jordan Kline: CI failed initially on Playwright run due to flaky timeouts; updated timeout_ms in tests to be more generous and retried. CI green now.
